title: PIMS Postdoctoral Fellowship
institution: Pacific Institute for the Mathematical Sciences (PIMS)
about: PIMS Postdoctoral Fellowship competition for the mathematical sciences, by nomination from a sponsor at a PIMS member university. Complete nominations and applications are due 1 December 2026 via MathJobs; sponsor forms by 5 December. Decisions by end of March.
requirements: Application by nomination only; unsolicited applications are not considered
Nominee needs a sponsor at a PIMS member university

upskill.name: Statistical & Mathematical Foundations I
why: field "Mathematical sciences" / skill "Mathematics" → "Apply inferential statistical methods, including hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, and analysis of variance (ANOVA), to draw conclusions from samples."

field "Mathematical sciences" → "Introduce Bayesian statistics and probabilistic modelling as approaches for representing uncertainty and updating analytical conclusions as new evidence becomes available."
Note: field-level match only; the stated requirements are nomination procedures, which no course covers.
